answer: The protocol gates identity through unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest agent. A verifier monitors the network, acting like a cold glacier to freeze any attempt at pooling compute by rejecting reused work patterns. Each agent must nurture a digital garden of non-repeatable solutions to qualify. A steady pulse of novel, work-bound challenges prevents batch generation. Evidence of duplicate logic triggers immediate, non-refundable account exclusion.
